name: catalyst_variance
verdict: NEGATIVE-EV variance play that failed at its own purpose: 0.0% of months cleared +30% (best month +11.9% in 8.6yr). -0.15%/mo real cost, EV -$75/trade, PF 0.87, N=190. Cash floor BREACHED in 4.16% of resampled paths — the floor caps deployment, not equity decline. INCONCLUSIVE (test N=65<100).
notes: Paper-competition variance play. Tail damped by 1.5% sizing; the lever is sizing not selection. Barred from live by design.
